_note: The ONE bidirectional synonym list for learner search (C2, 2026-10-17). Each group lists phrasings a learner may type for the same thing; searching any term also searches every other term in its group, in both directions, at a slightly lower weight than the words actually typed. Terms are lowercase with punctuation written as spaces ("first-episode psychosis" is "first episode psychosis"; the search normalises what the learner types the same way). Keep this list CONSERVATIVE and reviewable: a group is a statement that the phrases are interchangeable for finding pages, never a clinical claim, never a dose, and never a crisis route -- groups widen ordinary page matches only and never create or reorder a safety-protocol row (the safety kit keeps its own trigger vocabulary in curriculum.json). Loaded and validated at build time by site_build/search_synonyms.py, which fails the build on a malformed group; pinned by tests/search-synonyms.test.mjs and the golden queries in tests/fixtures/search-golden.json.
